item.nusmp.dungeon_ration_stew.lore: Thick, salty and exactly what a delver needs after a long floor.
item.nusmp.goblin_ear_jerky.lore: Dried, peppered and chewy. Tastes better than it sounds.
item.nusmp.adventurers_hardtack.lore: Keeps for a year and breaks teeth for two.
item.nusmp.mandrake_stew.lore: The root screams only if you hurry the pot.
item.nusmp.walking_mushroom_skewer.lore: Caught on a floor with fungal gardens, grilled before it can wander off.
item.nusmp.orc_haunch_roast.lore: A big roast for a big appetite.
item.nusmp.wyvern_steak.lore: Rare, red inside and worth the climb.
item.nusmp.bone_broth.lore: Simmered a full day from clean bones.
item.nusmp.kraken_fritter.lore: Golden outside, tender inside, salty like the deep.
item.nusmp.dryad_honey_cake.lore: Soft, sweet and warm from the grove.
item.nusmp.frostbite_sorbet.lore: So cold it fogs the bowl.
item.nusmp.ember_chili.lore: One spoon and the floor feels cooler.
item.nusmp.cave_mushroom_soup.lore: Glows faintly. So does the eater's grin.
item.nusmp.falna_cutlet.lore: A breaded cutlet that the guild cooks serve to those who come back.
item.nusmp.hearth_bread.lore: Baked at the Hub on a hearth that never goes out.
item.nusmp.delvers_trail_mix.lore: Nuts, dried berries and a few things nobody asks about.
item.nusmp.golem_stone_biscuit.lore: Hard as its name. Dip it.
item.nusmp.mana_elixir.lore: Restores a quarter of your magicules.
item.nusmp.aura_tonic.lore: Restores two fifths of your aura.
item.nusmp.wisp_draught.lore: A little magicule and a lot of lightness.
item.nusmp.starlit_nectar.lore: Restores two fifths of your magicules and mends a little.
item.nusmp.sages_elixir.lore: Restores most of your magicules and some aura. Take it slowly.
item.nusmp.healers_vial.lore: A mouthful of bright red restoration.
item.nusmp.fortitude_flask.lore: Two extra hearts of padding for a minute.
item.nusmp.swiftfoot_tonic.lore: Light feet and a spring in the step.
item.nusmp.berserkers_draught.lore: Hits harder for half a minute, and tastes of iron.
item.nusmp.goblin_ear.lore: A clipped goblin ear, kept as proof of the kill.
item.nusmp.goblin_tooth.lore: Small, yellow and sharper than it looks.
item.nusmp.orc_tusk.lore: A heavy curved tusk, good ivory for a smith.
item.nusmp.troll_hide.lore: Thick grey hide that closes its own cuts.
item.nusmp.bone_shard.lore: A splinter of old bone, hard enough for an arrowhead.
item.nusmp.ghoul_claw.lore: A black hooked claw from something that dug its way out.
item.nusmp.lich_dust.lore: Grey dust that hums with leftover magicules.
item.nusmp.wraith_essence.lore: A cold thread of a spirit that has not finished leaving.
item.nusmp.slime_gel.lore: Clear, wobbling and safe to cook.
item.nusmp.gel_core.lore: The firm bead at the centre of a slime.
item.nusmp.rusted_cog.lore: A toothed wheel from a construct's workings.
item.nusmp.golem_core.lore: The warm stone that tells a golem to stand up.
item.nusmp.cursed_cloth.lore: A rag from a cultist's robe that never quite stays still.
item.nusmp.cultist_sigil.lore: A tin badge stamped with a ring of small runes.
item.nusmp.imp_horn.lore: A small red horn, warm to the touch.
item.nusmp.shadow_core_shard.lore: A shard of a shadow's heart. The System's Shadow Core works in the same recipes.
item.nusmp.spirit_wisp.lore: A drifting spark of nature spirit, held in a glass-like skin.
item.nusmp.ember_heart.lore: A coal that is never quite out.
item.nusmp.beast_fang.lore: A long fang from a dungeon beast.
item.nusmp.drake_scale.lore: A hand-sized scale, tougher than most steel plate.
item.nusmp.kraken_ink.lore: Blue-black ink in a sealed gland.
item.nusmp.chitin_plate.lore: A curved plate of insect shell.
item.nusmp.venom_sac.lore: A tight gland of slow venom. Handle with a glove.
item.nusmp.shadowsteel_ingot.lore: Iron folded with a shard of shadow: dark, light and cold.
item.nusmp.bone_arrow.lore: An arrow with a bone-shard head. Hits a little harder than flint.
item.nusmp.goblin_fang_dagger.lore: Two goblin teeth for a point and a bad temper for an edge.
item.nusmp.delvers_longsword.lore: The plain blade of a hundred nameless delvers.
item.nusmp.bone_lance.lore: A shaft tipped with a long splinter of grave bone.
item.nusmp.orc_cleaver.lore: Heavy enough to ring a bell with the flat.
item.nusmp.shadowsteel_katana.lore: Folded with a shard of shadow; it drinks the light along its edge.
item.nusmp.drakefang_greatsword.lore: A slab of steel set with drake fang and scale.
item.nusmp.wisp_staff.lore: A twisted staff that holds a spirit wisp like a lantern.
item.nusmp.golem_maul.lore: A stone head on an iron haft, still faintly warm.
item.nusmp.drakescale_helm.lore: Overlapping scales over a leather cap.
item.nusmp.drakescale_vest.lore: A vest of drake scales sewn in rows.
item.nusmp.drakescale_greaves.lore: Scale-plated leggings that do not rattle.
item.nusmp.shadowsteel_helm.lore: A dark helm with a slit that seems deeper than it should.
item.nusmp.shadowsteel_cuirass.lore: A black cuirass that gives back no reflection.
item.nusmp.shadowsteel_greaves.lore: Light, dark and cold to the knee.
item.nusmp.shadowsteel_sabatons.lore: Footsteps in these make no echo.
item.nusmp.goblin_ear_ward.lore: Three ears on a cord. Goblins are said to leave the wearer alone; they do not.
item.nusmp.orc_tusk_ring.lore: A ring carved from a tusk and bound in iron.
item.nusmp.lich_dust_pendant.lore: A glass drop of lich dust on a chain.
item.nusmp.wisp_lantern.lore: A small lantern that keeps a wisp company.
item.nusmp.golem_core_belt.lore: A wide belt buckled round a golem core.
item.nusmp.wraith_cloak.lore: A cloak of cursed cloth that moves a half-step ahead of you.
item.nusmp.cultist_sigil_ring.lore: A ring stamped with a cultist's runes.
item.nusmp.tide_pearl_amulet.lore: A pearl on a silver wire; it is always cool.

message.nusmp.loot.nothing_to_sell: The Merchant has no use for that.
